run.question:
Alertmanager alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-27T04:22:54Z.
Alert expression (PromQL): label_replace(label_replace((sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))) / (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m]))), "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)") > 0.5
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert reflects a real error-rate jump on checkout's PlaceOrder server spans: at the last sampled point (04:22:54) the ERROR rate was 0.0144 spans/s versus 0.0042 spans/s without error status, i.e. ~77.6% error ratio, matching the alert's 77.63%. The failing path is checkout PlaceOrder -> payment Charge: over 04:13:04-04:23:04 the ERROR-span increases were identical (4.55) for checkout's PlaceOrder server span, checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, payment's server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, and the frontend/frontend-proxy/load-generator 500 spans. The payment Charge error spans carry the deterministic business-rule rejection 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' raised at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37, in 0.6-3.8 ms, so this is an application-level rejection in payment, not a timeout or transport failure. Failing spans were sampled from 04:18:56 onward and the first returned 5-minute ERROR increase point is 04:21:04 (4.24 errors), so the failure began shortly before the alert fired. Checkout's other downstream dependencies produced no ERROR spans in that window. Payment's flagd evaluation spans succeeded (rpc.grpc.status_code 0) and flagd serves a flag key 'paymentFailure' with reason STATIC, so a flag-driven fault injection for loyalty level gold is a plausible but unverified trigger. Latency is not a candidate: failures are sub-millisecond rejections.

claims.text: checkout PlaceOrder server spans show an error ratio of ~77.6% at the last sampled 5-minute point (04:22:54Z): STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate 0.01443 spans/s vs STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0.00417 spans/s, matching the alert's 77.63% figure.

In the 10-minute window 04:13:04Z-04:23:04Z the ERROR-status span increases were 4.55 for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 4.55 for checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, 4.55 for payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, and 4.55 for frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', frontend 'POST', frontend-proxy 'ingress'/'router frontend egress', and load-generator 'POST'; the same query returned no ERROR series for shipping, email, currency, cart, product-catalog, accounting, fraud-detection or quote.

payment's failing server spans (operation grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, service payment, service_version 2.0.2) carry grpc.error_name=Error and grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', with an exception.stacktrace pointing to /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 and index.js:21; their durations are 602-3810 microseconds and each is CHILD_OF a checkout client Charge span, which is in turn parented by the failing checkout PlaceOrder span.

payment's own metric series show grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate 0.01517 spans/s at 04:23:04Z versus STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0.00417 spans/s, and the ERROR series first appears in the returned points at 04:21:04Z with 0.01414 spans/s; payment's span_name 'charge' (internal) stayed STATUS_CODE_UNSET at ~0.0208 spans/s throughout.

checkout PlaceOrder ERROR-span increase over a 5-minute range selector first appears at 04:21:04Z with 4.24 errors, then 4.83 at 04:22:04Z and 4.55 at 04:23:04Z; no earlier point in the returned window 04:00:04Z-04:23:04Z carries the series, so the excess errors are recent rather than a long-standing condition.

payment's own outbound flag evaluation to flagd (span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat, child of the failing Charge span) has status tag rpc.grpc.status_code=0, i.e. the flag resolution call itself returns OK while Charge fails.

flagd exposes a feature-flag key named 'paymentFailure' (alongside adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure); its series feature_flag_flagd_result_reason_total{feature_flag_key="paymentFailure"} is served by k8s_deployment_name=flagd, k8s_namespace_name=otel-demo, pod flagd-d6485586b-fkt8k with feature_flag_reason=STATIC and rose from 1 to 2 between 04:18:04Z and 04:23:04Z.

payment's instance labels are k8s_deployment_name=payment, k8s_namespace_name=otel-demo, pod payment-6f7bc865d6-d7jt9; app_payment_transactions_total for currency USD rose only from 7 to 8 between 04:18:04Z and 04:23:04Z while ~4.5 Charge errors per 5 minutes were recorded, i.e. payment succeeded only about once per 5 minutes.

Latency/timeout is not the failure mode: the failing payment Charge spans complete in 602-3810 microseconds with an application error message and stacktrace, not a deadline-exceeded or connection error, and checkout's client-side Charge error spans take ~15-22 ms end to end.

A failure in checkout's own checkout logic or in another checkout dependency (cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping, email, accounting, fraud-detection, quote) was considered and rejected: the only ERROR-span series in the 10-minute window are on the checkout->payment Charge path plus frontend/frontend-proxy/load-generator propagation, and checkout's failing span's error text explicitly attributes the failure to 'failed to charge card ... Payment request failed. Invalid token'.

The trigger is a flagd feature-flag configuration for the 'paymentFailure' key served with reason STATIC (a static flag value, as opposed to flagd being unreachable), now returning the failing variant for charge requests whose evaluation context carries app.loyalty.level=gold; the error text's inclusion of 'app.loyalty.level=gold' and payment's successful ResolveFloat call to flagd support this, but the flag's current variant/value and any config change are not observable with the integrated sources.

The flagd EventStream ERROR spans seen for service_name flagd, ad and recommendation (1.207 errors over the 10 minutes ending 04:23:04Z) are a separate condition and are not shown by this evidence to cause payment's Charge rejections, since payment's flag evaluations return rpc.grpc.status_code=0; their relation to this incident remains unresolved.

Sampled error traces place the first observed failure at 04:18:56Z (span start 1795753136271000) and later ones at 04:18:56Z-04:21:22Z; a traces_search for checkout in 04:21:30Z-04:23:04Z returned no traces (data_as_of 04:21:22Z), so trace evidence stops about 100 s before the alert timestamp.

gaps: Payment/flagd Kubernetes object state, restarts and configuration change history cannot be checked: the kubernetes_state, pod_logs and change_history integrations are listed as not_integrated, so whether the 'paymentFailure' flag value or payment's environment changed shortly before 04:18-04:21Z is unknown.

The exact onset second is unknown: the earliest sampled failing trace starts at 04:18:56Z and the first returned 5-minute ERROR increase point is 04:21:04Z, while all 5-minute-rate points returned by the tool start only at 04:13:54Z and no comparable pre-incident error baseline series was returned (a 30-minute ERROR-increase query over 03:35:04Z-04:05:04Z returned no series at all, which is an empty match and not evidence of zero errors).

The current variant/value of the flagd flag key 'paymentFailure' and the loyalty-level targeting context are not exposed by any available metric or span; only the key name and reason=STATIC are visible.

Trace sampling/ingestion ends at 04:21:22Z, so the last ~100 s before the alert (04:21:30Z-04:23:04Z) contain no trace evidence, and the traces_search result set was a sampled projection (571 spans for 04:12-04:23, of which only a 30-row slice was read).

Whether the flagd/ad/recommendation EventStream ERROR spans predate this incident is unknown: the 2-hour EventStream error query returned only the final 10-minute point, so no earlier comparison exists.
next_steps: Check the flagd feature-flag configuration (flag key 'paymentFailure' and its loyalty-level targeting/variants) and its change history around 2026-11-27T04:15Z-04:20Z, using a change-history or Kubernetes/ConfigMap source that is not integrated in this Run.
Confirm payment deployment (payment, pod payment-6f7bc865d6-d7jt9, namespace otel-demo) configuration/environment changes and restarts in the same time range via kubernetes_state or pod_logs.

Verify with payment pod logs whether the 'Invalid token' rejection is emitted only for gold-loyalty charges and whether any charge path still succeeds, to size customer impact before any remediation is approved.
